windows_app.user_reported_symptom: 1.0.0/1.0.1 on real Windows: 'Starting VLCFlix' text ~5s, then total black; maximising and clicking closes the app. 1.0.1 log shows every HRESULT = 0 (environment, controller, get_CoreWebView2, Navigate all S_OK) but NavigationStarting/NavigationCompleted never fire, so the page never loads.
v101_fixes: full HRESULT instrumentation at every WebView2 step, logged to launcher.log
native fallback panel replaces the black window and keeps the app open
logging moved to the first statement of wWinMain so early exits are recorded
single-instance exit is now logged instead of being silent
v102_changes: watchdog (8s): if NavigationCompleted never fires, log full browser state and escalate
second attempt with WEBVIEW2_ADDITIONAL_BROWSER_ARGUMENTS=--disable-gpu in a separate profile
every previously unchecked call now logged (put_IsVisible, put_Bounds via failure, all add_*Event, get_Settings)
LogWebViewState(): visible / bounds / source / browserPid captured when an attempt is abandoned
the loading label now stays on top of the webview until the page actually paints (no unexplained black)
SetUnhandledExceptionFilter writes exception code, address and module to launcher.log
accurate final message: 'runtime could not be started (hr)' vs 'started but never drew the page'
windows_app.next_diagnostic_step: user runs 1.0.2; if it still fails, launcher.log will contain [webview2] state: visible=.. bounds=.. source=.. browserPid=.. at watchdog time, plus attempt 1 with --disable-gpu
windows_app.root_cause_found: ICoreWebView2Controller is a BORROWED reference inside the completed handler. Storing it without AddRef let the runtime destroy it as soon as Invoke returned, which per MS docs closes the WebView. Hence: Navigate returned S_OK (called inside the handler) but no navigation event ever fired and nothing painted (black window); later puts (put_Bounds on WM_SIZE, the watchdog state dump) dereferenced freed memory -> 0xC0000005 crash. Fixed in 1.0.3 with controller->AddRef().
v103_changes: controller->AddRef() before storing it; Released in TearDownWebView()
LogWebViewState only trusts out-params whose call returned S_OK
